subject: general
question: Who was the first political personality to discuss the concept of 'Poverty Line'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Dadabhai Naoroji.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji** in his book**, "Poverty and unBritish Rule in India" **made the earliest estimation of the** poverty line.**
 
• He estimated **Rs, 16 to 35 per capita per year.**
 
• The poverty line proposed by him was based **on the cost of a subsistence or minimum basic diet** (rice or flour, dal, mutton, vegetables, ghee, vegetable oil, and salt).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• ** Dadabhai Naoroj**i

 
 
• He is also known as the** Grand Old Man of India**.
 
• He was the **2nd and 9th President of the Indian National Congress.**
 
• He put forward the** 'drain of wealth' theory** in which he stated that Britain was completely draining India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Mahatma Gandh**i

 
 
• He is known as the** 'father of Nation'.**
 
• He was the** primary leader of India's independence movement **and also the architect of a form of** non-violent civil disobedience that would influence** the world.
 
 
 
• **Rajendra Prasad**
 
 
• He was the** first president of India.**
 
• He was one of the **first to receive the Bharat Ratna in 1962.**
 
 
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**
 
 
• He is considered the** 'father of the Indian Renaissance**.
 
• He is renowned for his pioneering role in **opposing practices like Sati, child marriage, and social divisions.**
